# b should compile only Box[int] instantiations still referenced after inlining.
# Negative checks match defined symbols (with an address), not U references.

go build -o b.a ./b
go tool nm b.a
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Called$'
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Value$'
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Expr$'
stdout ' T example/a\.id\[go\.shape\.int\]$'              # called by Called
stdout ' T example/a\.get\[go\.shape\.int\]\.1$'          # get's closure in Called.func1
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.string\]\.Unused$'  # not in package a
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int8\]\.Value$'     # via b.Emb wrapper
! stdout ' T .*Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Inlined$'
! stdout '[0-9a-f] [^U] .*Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Unused'  # unused (and its closure)
! stdout '[0-9a-f] [^U] .*apply\[go\.shape\.int\]'        # inlined into Unused

# -d=genericsdedup=0 compiles them all.
go build -gcflags=-d=genericsdedup=0 -o b0.a ./b
go tool nm b0.a
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Inlined$'
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Unused$'
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Unused\.func1$'
stdout ' T example/a\.apply\[go\.shape\.int\]\.1$'

# Disabled for custom maxshapelen and runtime (-+).
go build -gcflags=-d=maxshapelen=499 -o b1.a ./b
go tool nm b1.a
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Unused$'
go build -gcflags=-+ -o b2.a ./b
go tool nm b2.a
stdout ' T example/a\.Box\[go\.shape\.int\]\.Unused$'

# Build (with DWARF) and run. main calls Unused via interface using a's copy.
go build -o prog.exe .
exec ./prog.exe
stderr '^1 2 3 4 5 ab 6$'

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.27
-- a/a.go --
package a

type Box[T any] struct{ V T }

// Exposes Box[int] so package a compiles its methods.
func New(v int) Box[int] { return Box[int]{v} }

// Exposes Box[int8] for b.Emb.
func New8(v int8) Box[int8] { return Box[int8]{v} }

// Deferred closure stays out of line, so inlining get copies its closure.
//go:noinline
func (b Box[T]) Called() (v T) {
	defer func() { v = id(get(get(b.V))) }()
	return
}

//go:noinline
func (b Box[T]) Value() T { return b.V }

//go:noinline
func (b Box[T]) Expr() T { return b.V }

func (b Box[T]) Inlined() T { return b.V }

//go:noinline
func (b Box[T]) Unused() (v T) {
	defer func() { v = apply(b.V) }()
	return
}

//go:noinline
func id[T any](v T) T { return v }

// Direct closure call, so inlining copies the closure.
func get[T any](v T) (r T) {
	func() { r = v }()
	return
}

func apply[T any](v T) (r T) {
	func() { r = v }()
	return
}
-- b/b.go --
package b

import "example/a"

func Called() int  { return a.New(1).Called() }
func Inlined() int { return a.New(2).Inlined() }

var Value = a.New(3).Value

var expr = a.Box[int].Expr

func Expr() int { return expr(a.New(4)) }

func Any() any { return a.New(5) }

func String() string { return a.Box[string]{V: "ab"}.Unused() }

// Promoted wrapper calls Box[int8]'s methods.
type Emb struct{ a.Box[int8] }

func Embedded() any { return Emb{a.New8(6)} }
-- main.go --
package main

import "example/b"

func main() {
	u := b.Any().(interface{ Unused() int })
	e := b.Embedded().(interface{ Value() int8 })
	println(b.Called(), b.Inlined(), b.Value(), b.Expr(), u.Unused(), b.String(), e.Value())
}
